'''June 2000 Las Vegas tournament (11 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas, Nevada on 11 June 2000. It is known from Dan Christy's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d885">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-las-vegas-6-11-00d885/ las-vegas-6-11-00], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 12 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-las-vegas-6-11-00d885/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, Nevada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
